answer: Proof of Work provides robust Sybil resistance for AI agents by requiring computational expenditure to participate. As the network pulse quickens, attackers face an economic nadir where the cost of hashing power eclipses any potential gain from fraudulent nodes. Just as one must plant an entire orchard to yield a harvest, an agent must commit real hardware resources to earn influence, making the proliferation of cheap, synthetic identities prohibitively expensive and technically unsustainable.
